lines.text: When the land is divided by lot, a holy portion is set aside for the LORD, with a sanctuary 500 cubits square.
The holy strip is for the priests who minister in the sanctuary, and the adjacent strip belongs to the Levites for towns.
God tells the princes of Israel to stop violence and oppression, and to use honest scales.
On the first day of the first month a young bull purifies the sanctuary, and on the fourteenth day the Feast of Weeks begins.
On Passover the prince provides a bull as a sin offering for himself and all the priests of the land.
